name: Andou Ryouko
source:
The protagonist's kouhai, who graduated from the same university.
Back in those days, certain things happened, guiding them into knowing each other and tied them in a love-hate relationship. After graduation, she also joined the same company as the protagonist. She is still labeled as his kouhai all the way through.
Being with the protagonist, she is always the assertive one, although she lacks courage to take the crucial step forward.
Annoying the protagonist is her special talent.
Hates overtime work.
